adjustment.analysis: Father's Day (Sun) is a strong driver with a noise-adjusted historical lift of x1.72, supported by two past occurrences. The price is unchanged (2.82), so no price effect. The baseline trend shows a steep decline (-63.3% over 13 weeks), but the event effect is distinct and well-documented. No evidence of pantry loading or supply risk. The noise-adjusted lift is robust enough to justify full adjustment.
